notes: Pure digital protocol block; no analog reference / trim / calibration loop. Baud-rate is purely from a digital divider chain of the BusClock.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Modulation current amplitude
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the sensor's current-modulation pulses are at the nominal +-26 mA on the loop.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Manchester bit timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the Manchester-coded bit period matches the configured 125/189 kbps and that mid-bit transitions are clean.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Sync-pulse / time-slot timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate the ECU sync pulse and the sensors' time-slot offsets (synchronous mode).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Telegram CRC / parity
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Inject errors and confirm the 2-bit/3-bit CRC or parity detects them.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Loop current / power budget
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the sensor is correctly loop-powered and the quiescent + modulation current is within range.
